verdict.rationale: Digits ships 'Ask Digits' as an in-product AI assistant that answers financial questions and completes tasks ('Ask questions. Complete tasks. Understand your business'), plus AI-driven trend insights, exception surfacing, and quality-control checks embedded in dashboards and the Agentic Close workflow. This is corroborated by a live, auth-gated MCP server exposing the same ledger data for AI-generated insights externally, reinforcing the product's AI-native insight capability. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reviews validating the quality of Ask Digits' insights beyond vendor claims.
